Job Description

Do you have extensive experience leading large-scale, complex IT engagements and building strong, long-term client relationships? Are you motivated by delivering innovative digital solutions? If so, you could play a key role within our Digital Government Business Unit.

Responsibilities and Technologies

As we continue to expand rapidly in the German public sector market, we are looking for a German-speaking professional who can take responsibility for complex IT deliveries while contributing to the continued development of our client partnerships.

In this role, you will lead large, complex IT engagements and work closely with clients and project teams to ensure high-quality delivery and successful outcomes. You will manage expectations, advise clients, and navigate complex stakeholder environments while building strong client relationships and identifying opportunities to further develop existing collaborations. You will also play an important role in adopting, understanding, and communicating Netcompany’s DNA, delivery model, methodology, and ways of working. Combining strong delivery capabilities with commercial awareness, you will engage with key stakeholders, participate in steering committee meetings, and contribute to the continued growth of our engagements.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Leading large, complex IT engagements and ensuring successful delivery, progress, and high-quality outcomes.

• Building strong, long-term relationships with clients and key stakeholders, including participating in steering committee meetings.

• Advising clients, managing expectations, and supporting key decisions throughout the delivery.

• Identifying opportunities to develop and expand existing client engagements and contributing to the commercial growth of established partnerships.

• Coordinating and working closely with project teams and colleagues across Netcompany to ensure successful delivery and continued development of client engagements.

About you

To succeed in this role, you:

• Have a strong technical understanding and extensive experience delivering complex IT projects and solutions.

• Have proven experience leading large and complex IT delivery projects, including projects utilizing agile development methodologies.

• Have a strong commercial awareness and a solid understanding of the German public sector market, combined with the ability to build trust and develop strong client relationships.

• Can advise clients on project deliverables while identifying opportunities to further develop existing collaborations.

• Are fluent in German and English at a full professional level and have strong professional communication skills in an international environment.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Partaking alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Senior Business Partner People & Organization (P&O)

A broad and highly visible P&O role at the heart of Xellia’s global organization

Are you an experienced P&O professional who combines strong business understanding with a pragmatic yet ambitious approach and the ability to get things done?

Xellia Pharmaceuticals is looking for a Senior Business Partner P&O to take on a broad and highly visible role at our Copenhagen headquarters. You will work across both strategic and operational P&O priorities and play an important role in translating Xellia’s strategy into organizational capability, strong leadership practices and pragmatic P&O solutions.

This is a role for someone who enjoys operating in a fast-paced, ambitious and performance-driven international environment. You will interact with senior leaders and executives across the organization and take ownership of several important global P&O processes while remaining close to the day-to-day execution.

In other words, this is not a role where strategy and execution are separated. You will get the opportunity to do both.

Your role

As Senior Business Partner P&O, you will become part of Xellia’s global People & Organization function and work from our headquarters in Copenhagen.

You will act as a trusted sparring partner to senior leaders while taking direct ownership of a broad portfolio of P&O activities. A significant part of your role will be to ensure that processes are not only designed, but implemented, followed through and continuously improved.

Talent Acquisition will be an important part of your role. You will manage selected senior and strategically important recruitments across the organization, covering the process from talent attraction and sourcing through assessment, selection and offer. In addition, you will provide hands-on Talent Acquisition support to the Copenhagen site when needed and contribute to continuously strengthening Xellia’s approach to recruitment and talent attraction.

Your broader responsibilities will include:

• Driving selected global organizational review processes, including succession planning, organizational assessments and input to workforce and capability planning

• Driving the global performance management cycle and supporting leaders on performance-related matters

• Acting as a trusted P&O partner to leaders and providing pragmatic, business-oriented advice

• Driving and developing learning and development initiatives, including implementation of Xellia’s global competency framework

• Supporting leadership development and coordinating relevant leadership training and coaching initiatives

• Contributing to employee engagement activities, including analysis, action planning and follow-up

• Supporting employer branding activities in Copenhagen

• Managing external recruitment, assessment and development partners and ensuring both quality and commercial relevance

• Leading and contributing to global and local P&O projects and new initiatives

You will also play an active role in developing how Xellia uses AI and technology within P&O. This already includes AI-supported tools for job descriptions, job advertisements and structured interview guides, and we expect you to help identify further opportunities where technology can improve quality, speed and the employee and manager experience.

The formal scope spans strategic and operational P&O support, talent acquisition, performance management, organizational development, leadership development and vendor management. We do not expect you to be a unicorn who has mastered every aspect of P&O. We are looking for a passionate and committed professional who sees the opportunity in a broad portfolio of responsibilities and is motivated by taking ownership, creating momentum and successfully juggling the many different priorities the role entails.

Who are you?

We expect you to have a solid background from a senior HR role, ideally from an international and commercially oriented organization where expectations, pace and stakeholder complexity are high.

You probably bring:

• Strong experience within Talent Acquisition, preferably including senior and strategically important recruitments, combined with experience across several broader HR disciplines

• Experience driving organizational processes such as organizational reviews, succession planning, performance management or workforce planning

• Experience working directly with senior leaders and the confidence to challenge constructively when needed

• A strong business mindset and an ability to translate organizational needs into pragmatic solutions

• Experience managing projects and processes across functions and geographies

• An interest in how AI, data and technology can strengthen HR/P&O

• Strong communication skills and professional fluency in English

Experience from pharmaceuticals, life sciences or another highly regulated industry can be an advantage, but is not a prerequisite.

More importantly, you understand what it takes to operate successfully in an international corporate environment with high expectations for quality, responsiveness and execution.

The person we are looking for

Your way of working will be just as important as your HR toolbox.

You are quick-thinking, resourceful and action-oriented, and you naturally create momentum around the activities you own. You are comfortable moving between senior stakeholder discussions and very practical execution – sometimes within the same hour.

You have the maturity and robustness to navigate different perspectives and senior stakeholders in an international organization, and you communicate clearly and confidently.

At the same time, you have a strong hands-on mentality. You take ownership, follow through and do not consider operational tasks beneath your level. You thrive in a role where the breadth is significant, priorities can shift quickly, and delivering high-quality support to the business matters.

A bit about us

Xellia is a 120-year-old company with a refreshingly start-up feel inside. We have spent more than a century at the forefront of anti-infective medicine, making a difference to patients all over the world – and we are just as ambitious today as we were a hundred years ago.

We have recently refreshed our brand around a simple, human idea: We’re Your People. It is built on the strong relationships and trusted partnerships that have always defined Xellia, putting the real Xellians – the warm, expert and dedicated people behind the science – front and center.

Why Xellia?

Because you will be joining at a genuinely exciting moment – with a refreshed brand, real momentum and the rare combination of a 120-year heritage with start-up energy inside. The work matters. The medicines we make help patients in some of the most critical moments of their lives.

For the right person, this role offers a compelling combination of seniority, breadth, international exposure and hands-on responsibility. You will have the opportunity to influence important global P&O processes, work closely with senior stakeholders and help develop how Xellia approaches talent, performance, organizational capability and the use of new technology within P&O.

And because here, you are not just a hire – you are one of us.

We’re Your People. Come and be one of them.

Practical information

The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark. Workplace presence is expected approximately four days per week, and occasional travel may be required.

Contact and application

The recruitment process is handled by European Search Company on behalf of Xellia Pharmaceuticals. All inquiries are treated confidentially.

For additional information about the position, please contact Christoffer Bjørk Petersen on +45 20 80 16 38 or Brian Ranvits on +45 20 48 05 48.

If you see yourself in the position, please send your application by using the Apply button below.

Software Developer and Consultant for Life Science & Pharma Industry

About DAQUMA

In the summer of 2022, Bjarke, Peter and Sille started a new consultancy supporting life science companies with various elements of IT implementation. DAQUMA is a Technology and Data solution provider that helps life science companies succeed through implementations, data migrations, data integration, data management and quality control.

We believe in flexibility, flat hierarchies, and the freedom to shape both DAQUMA’s journey and your own professional path.

About the role

We are looking for a Software Developer and Consultant to support our Life Science and Pharma clients with the implementation and integration of our platform, DAQUMA:AI.

DAQUMA:AI is built on Microsoft Azure Services, and your role will primarily focus on integrating our platform into clients’ existing enterprise and regulated IT environments.

This is a client-facing consulting role where you will work directly with stakeholders to implement integrations, support deployment activities, and contribute to the technical implementation of our software.

You will:

• Collaborate with clients to understand their IT landscape, workflows, and integration needs.

• Implement and configure IT solutions based on client specifications.

• Design and implement integrations using Azure-native services such as API Management, Logic Apps, and App Services.

• Support the deployment of AI-driven document and data processing solutions.

• Troubleshoot technical issues and provide technical support.

• Conduct onboarding sessions and workshops for clients on DAQUMA:AI.

• Connect and harmonize data across enterprise systems such as Veeva Vault.

• Deliver on and support migration projects and other implementation projects for clients.

About you

You bring:

• A strong consulting mindset and a passion for delivering impactful client solutions.

• Hands-on experience working with the Microsoft Azure cloud platform.

• Experience with system and API integrations in enterprise environments.

• Experience in client-facing implementation or consulting roles.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to engage with both business and IT stakeholders.

• The ability to work independently as well as in collaborative teams.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus:

• Life Science / Pharma industry experience.

• Experience in regulated environments (e.g., GxP).

• Veeva Vault experience.

• Previous consultancy experience.

• Relevant Azure certifications such as AZ204, AZ305, or AI102 are considered a plus; however, proven hands-on implementation experience is prioritized over certifications.

Location

On-site at our office in Nordvest, Copenhagen. Hybrid work flexibility is possible, and travel to client offices may be required.

What we offer

At DAQUMA, our team is what makes the difference. We invest in your growth through:

• A competitive salary and compensation package.

• A dedicated mentor to support your professional development.

• Exciting engagements within the Life Science and Pharma sectors.

• Continuous learning with a dedicated training budget.

• A dynamic scale-up culture where you can actively shape the company.

Formalities

If you want to join this exciting venture and help our clients reach their goals, please submit your CV by uploading it here on our website or emailing it to recruitment@daquma.com.

Find us on LinkedIn.

Are you looking for a role where you can combine theoretical computer vision, hardware integration, and robust software development?

Trackman is looking for a Computer Vision Engineer to join our Golf Launch Monitor R&D team. You will join the team in building high-precision tracking systems engineered to perform reliably in challenging environments and satisfy the highest requirements of elite athletes.

Whether you are a recent graduate or have a couple of years of experience in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded/mechatronics, or related fields, this is an opportunity to build deep technical expertise while working hands-on with some of the most challenging problems in computer vision and sensor technology.

Since 2003, Trackman has been on the forefront of sports tracking technology, combining high-speed cameras, radar, and applied physics. Our products are used daily by professional athletes, coaches, club fitters, and broadcasters worldwide. Staying at the forefront requires more than developing new technology. It means continuously  improving, testing, and hardening existing systems, so they work flawlessly every single day in real-world conditions.

The Role

As a Computer Vision Engineer, you will work across the development lifecycle: running feasibility studies on new optical sensors, helping design real-time tracking pipelines, and taking pride in diagnosing, maintaining, and improving products across demanding deployment environment.

We are looking for motivated engineers who pair a strong theoretical academic foundation with the practical instinct to roll up their sleeves, diagnose tricky integration bottlenecks, and build technology that works.

You will join the Golf Launch Monitors R&D team, a highly skilled, multidisciplinary group of specialists working across computer vision, radar signal processing, mathematical modeling, and software engineering. We are committed to excellence and operate with a first-principles mindset, constantly pushing physical and computational boundaries to ensure our tracking accuracy remains the global benchmark.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Sensor & Hardware Integration: Evaluate next-generation camera sensors, optical setups, and custom illumination; diagnose hardware/software interface edge cases (e.g., latency, frame drops, synchronization).

• 
Algorithm & Pipeline Design: Develop, tune, and profile real-time 2D/3D vision tracking and calibration algorithms capable of handling all kinds of challenging cases.

• 
Production Engineering & Maintenance: Write clean, testable C++ and Python code. Maintain, refactor, and harden existing production codebases to ensure long-term stability and high uptime.

• 
Field-Data Validation: Analyze real-world datasets collected across challenging environments to identify vulnerabilities, eliminate subtle tracking bugs, and continuously raise tracking accuracy.

• 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, firmware, and QA teams to translate ambiguous physical challenges into reliable, deployable software solutions.

Who You Are:

• 
You are a recent MSc/PhD graduate or early-career engineer with approximately 0–3 years of experience in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field.

• 
You have gained hands-on experience with computer vision, sensors, image processing,

• 
You have a strong interest in – areas such as camera sensors, calibration, 3D geometry, feature tracking, or image-processing pipelines.

• 
You have gained experience in software engineering through professional research, or substantial university projects.

• 
You have strong academic or practical skills in C++ and/or Python and care about writing efficient, structured, and maintainable code.

• 
You enjoy solving complex technical problems, digging into code and data, and investigating issues until you understand their root cause.

• 
You are curious, highly motivated, organized, and comfortable taking ownership in a collaborative and informal engineering environment.

Bonus Points For:

Experience or interest in any of the following is an advantage:

• 
High-speed or global-shutter imaging

• 
Embedded Linux or RTOS

• 
Camera-radar sensor fusion

• 
CUDA, SIMD, TensorRT, or similar acceleration technologies

• 
Sports technology, biomechanics, or golf tracking

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Are you passionate about data privacy and can you drive tasks and projects across the finish line?

The Data Privacy team at Ascendis Pharma A/S is looking for a motivated Student Assistant who wants hands-on experience of data privacy in an international company.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Student Assistant to join our Data Privacy team as our current fantastic student has now graduated. As a key member of the team, you will play a crucial role in supporting and strengthening our Data Privacy program and culture. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining the Data Privacy team, part of the larger Compliance team consisting of 14 dedicated colleagues, working within Compliance, Data Privacy, Risk Management, and ESG. You will report directly to the Senior Director Data Privacywho is based in Hellerup, Denmark.You will also be based in Hellerup.

• Supporting various data privacy projects and tasks, e.g., keeping our records of processing, legitimate interest assessments (LIAs) and risk assessments up to date

Ideally, you are a bachelor student or in the first year of your master’s studies in law or business administration or another relevant field.

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be a strong finisher who perseveres until all tasks are completed.

Combilent is an entrepreneurial company specializing in the design and manufacture of high-performance solutions in the fields of Land Mobile Radio. Despite employing only 25, Combilent is the preferred supplier of components for critical communication to all the largest OEMs in US and Europe, providing premium and highly advanced components behind communication equipment to first responders such as police and alarm centrals. Being part of the Indutrade Group, a Swedish investment company with a vast network of technical companies, Combilent also benefit from their solid market presence and long-term approach to business, looking to grow organically, providing strong support to the companies in the group. Indutrade is recognized for its focus on sustainable growth and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) strategies, driving sustainable practices across its portfolio of businesses. We are located in Farum, north of Copenhagen and are looking for a:

Sales & Business Development Manager

Business Development – Driving New Business

Combilent has had a solid and profitable business within Land Mobile Radio (LMR) for more than 20 years, and this remains a strong foundation for the company. However, our growth ambitions go beyond LMR. We have built deep expertise and strong relationships as a niche OEM supplier of mechatronics with integrated software and Radio Frequency (RF) technology  and we now want to leverage this platform to build a second leg of business.

Therefore we target to develop an entirely new customer base of OEMs in sectors following today’s major technology trends, while leveraging our position as a niche OEM supplier.

Your job will be to bring new ideas and business opportunities, and open new doors through networking. We offer startup-up speed in combination with access to funding through our owner, and know-how to execute.

You will report to the CEO and work very closely with her and with the founder (CCO) of the company, who plays a pivotal role regarding products and customers.

Key Responsibilities – Building New Ground

In a small entrepreneurial team there will be good opportunities to shape the role, and you will, among other things, be responsible for:

• Identifying and developing new business beyond our current customer base by building relations with new OEM customers in emerging sectors such as Defense, AI, Drones and IoT and expanding into new verticals with current OEM’s through new networking.

• Generating and testing new business ideas through extensive networking outside our current contacts, translating market trends and macro shifts into concrete opportunities for the Combilent

• Building strong relationships and new networks with key customers and partners to generate leads and close new business

• Staying ahead of market trends, emerging technologies, and customer preferences to inform product development and sales strategy

• Building and presenting business cases for new products and market entries, including go-to-market strategies, and resource needs

• Playing an active role at all levels of the business, from high-level strategic discussions to hands-on sales and operational tasks, reflecting the entrepreneurial spirit of Combilent

What You Bring – A Networker and Idea-Generator

Most likely, you hold a degree in Engineering, Business, MBA or related field. You have 5+ years of experience in sales, business management and/or product development, in an industry that is tech focused. You have a hunter profile and get your energy from finding business opportunities and convert them into business. Furthermore, you are experienced in strategic thinking combined with an entrepreneurial mindset, and with the ability to thrive in a small business environment where everyone contributes.

What We Offer – Room to Build Something New

We offer a compensation package that matches your qualifications, including a pension and a bonus scheme, but just as importantly, we offer exciting professional challenges and a team that values openness and good collaboration as well as a culture, where we treat each other well. You will get a key role in a small, innovative company, providing opportunities to make a significant impact on the future direction of the company. You will get autonomy to shape and lead new business ventures, with the opportunity to influence both product development and acquisition strategies.

Application and contact

The application and selection process will be done in collaboration with Brinch & Partners. If you would like to know more about this opportunity and the company, please feel free to contact Partner Martin Bo Sørensen by phone +45 27847406.

We look forward to receiving your CV as soon as possible through the “Apply” button below.

Join SAS as we step confidently into a new era of growth and innovation.

Long known as one of the world’s most punctual, sustainable, and innovative airlines, we are now preparing for our largest summer program ever in 2026, opening new routes across Europe, North America, and Asia.

With a modern fleet of more than 100 aircraft, SAS offers a truly varied and rewarding flying experience. From the unique demands of Nordic winter operations to navigating some of the world’s busiest international airspaces, you’ll enjoy a flying environment that is both challenging and deeply fulfilling.

As SAS continues to expand with up to 55 Embraer E195-E2 aircraft joining our fleet, we are looking for Captains and experienced First Officers ready for command. Join us and be part of the next exciting chapter of this growing, respected, and future focused Scandinavian airline.

jobs.occupation: Specialistläkare i neurolog til Midt- og Vestsjællands hospital Slagelse, Danmark
jobs.description:
Nyinrättad tjänst med inriktning mot akutsjukvård och samarbete med Rigshospitalet

Vi utökar vår specialistläkargrupp vid Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i samband med uppbyggnaden av en ny akutneurologisk verksamhet. Du kommer att ha stort professionellt inflytande över vår kommande akutvårdsverksamhet och kommer att ingå i ett nytt, nära samarbete med Rigshospitalet.

Varför ska du välja oss?

• Skapa framtidens akutvård: Du kommer att ha en central roll i uppbyggnaden och lanseringen av vår kommande akutneurologiska verksamhet (exklusive trombolys).

• Nytt samarbete med Rigshospitalet: Samarbetet öppnar dörrar för branschöverskridande samverkan, kunskapsutbyte och forskning. För den som är intresserad finns dessutom möjlighet till attraktiva deltidsanställningar (t.ex. en dag i veckan på RH).

• Nya yrkesområden från och med den 1 januari 2027: Till följd av hälso- och sjukvårdsreformen tar vi över den specialiserade rehabiliteringen från kommunerna, vilket ger spännande möjligheter till yrkesmässig utveckling.

• Utrymme för din subspecialisering: Oavsett om ditt intresse ligger inom MS, rörelsestörningar, huvudvärk, demens, epilepsi eller rehabilitering anpassar vi ramarna så att du kan fördjupa dig inom ditt område.

• En stark forskningsmiljö: Vi fokuserar på multisjuka patienter och har en egen professor i neurologi, vars forskning främst är inriktad på multipel skleros.

Din profil

Du är specialistläkare i neurologi – och är antingen nyutexaminerad och vill utvecklas eller en erfaren kollega som söker nya utmaningar.

Vi tror att du:

• brinner för det tvärvetenskapliga samarbetet och vill bidra till kvaliteten på den nya akutmottagningen

• anser att ett nära professionellt samarbete mellan olika sjukhus är värdefullt

• ser stort värde i klinisk vägledning och handledning av våra yngre läkare

• är beslutsam, flexibel och bidrar aktivt till vår goda arbetsmiljö och vår pionjäranda.

Vardagen och uppgifterna

Vår avdelning tar hand om patienter på huvudfunktionsnivå i Slagelse (sjukhusavdelning för fas II-rehabilitering, främst stroke, samt specialistkliniker) och i Næstved, där vi driver Center for Neurorehabilitering (CNN) som har en regionfunktion.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att omfatta

• arbete vid vår öppenvårdsmottagning, våra specialkliniker eller den tvärvetenskapliga minneskliniken (i samarbete med geriatriker, psykiatriker och neuropsykologer)

• handledning av yngre läkare samt deltagande i det tvärvetenskapliga samarbetet mellan olika kliniker.

• jouransvar: specialistläkarna sköter för närvarande bakjourstjänstgöringen på plats fram till kl. 21.00, varefter de har beredskapsjour från hemmet (primärjour finns på plats dygnet runt).

Om avdelningen

Neurologin ingår i en samlad avdelning (Medicin 3 och Avdelningen för fysioterapi och arbetsterapi), där vi har ett nära och välfungerande samarbete med geriatriken. Vi lägger stor vikt vid yrkesmässigt utbyte inom en läkargrupp som präglas av god kollegial sammanhållning och en vilja att utveckla yrket.

Praktisk information och ansökan

• De sju läkarrollerna: Din ansökan ska förhålla sig konkret till de sju medicinska kompetensområdena och innehålla så utförlig dokumentation som möjligt.

• Intressen: Om du har särskilda önskemål gällande subspecialisering eller är intresserad av en delad tjänst med Rigshospitalet, får du gärna ange detta i din ansökan.

Vill du veta mer?

Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta överläkare Benedikte Wanscher på mobilnummer +45 93 57 62 51 eller via e-post till bewa@regionsjaelland.dk för ett konfidentiellt samtal om tjänsten utan förpliktelser.

Villkor, lön och anställning

Anställningen sker enligt avtalet mellan Danske Regioner och YL/Overlægeforeningen, beroende på vilken tjänst som söks.

Det kan finnas möjligheter till anställning enligt ”skatteordningen for højtlønnede” (innebär att du som utländsk specialist, forskare eller högavlönad får en betydligt lägre och förenklad inkomstskatt i Danmark under en begränsad period) för sökande som uppfyller villkoren för detta. Läs mer här

Tjänsten ska tillsättas så snart som möjligt.

I din ansökan eller ditt CV ska du hänvisa till de sju läkartjänsterna och ange om du söker en tjänst som specialistläkare eller överläkare. Om du har några särskilda intressen eller önskemål angående tjänsten får du gärna beskriva dessa i din ansökan.

Bifoga relevant dokumentation.

Hjälp med flytt och undervisning i danska

Om du vill flytta till Danmark i samband med anställningen erbjuder vi kostnadsfri, professionell hjälp med flytt och bosättning nära sjukhuset eller eventuellt i Köpenhamn. Du får hjälp med allt från att hitta boende till registrering och eventuella medföljande familjemedlemmar.

En viktig del av arbetet som specialistläkare är kommunikationen mellan läkare och patient. För patientsäkerhetens skull kräver därför Region Sjælland att våra specialistläkare ska ha kunskaper i danska språket på en tillfredsställande nivå. Vi tillhandahåller därför en språklärare för privatundervisning så att du så snabbt som möjligt kan kommunicera med dina patienter på en nivå där ni förstår varandra.

Det innebär att vi förväntar oss att du är inställd på att lägga tid på att lära dig danska, både i tal och skrift.

Se mer om vad vi erbjuder i form av hjälp här

Rekryteringsprocessen

När vi har mottagit din ansökan kommer vi att bedöma om dina kvalifikationer matchar det vi söker, och du kommer initialt att bjudas in till en intervju via Teams. Om båda parter är intresserade av att fortsätta dialogen kommer du att bjudas in till ett rekryteringssamtal på sjukhuset, där du får träffa avdelningens ledning och personal samt vår HR- och språkkonsult.

Ansökningstid

Vi kommer att granska ansökningarna till tjänsten löpande, så vänta inte för länge med att ansöka.

Verksamhetsområde

Den 1 januari 2027 slås Region Själland och Region Hovedstaden samman och bildar Region Østdanmark till följd av sjukvårdsreformen. Ditt verksamhetsområde kommer att vara Region Østdanmark, inklusive alla tillhörande organisatoriska enheter.

Läs mer om vad verksamhetsområdet innebär på Region Østdanmarks webbplats.

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbetar vi varje dag för att främja ett hälsosamt liv genom förebyggande åtgärder och behandling inom ramen för en samordnad hälso- och sjukvårdsinsats. Som sjukhus förenar vi psykiatri och somatik. Vårt mål är att patienter och medborgare ska få bra och trygg vård av hög kvalitet.

Som medarbetare blir du en del av ett innovativt, kompetent och organisatoriskt stabilt sjukhus där vi gör skillnad för de människor som behöver oss. Lärande och utveckling är en del av vardagen och sker i professionella sammanhang med ett gemensamt ansvar. Det sker även mellan olika avdelningar.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital betjänar ett upptagningsområde med cirka 230 000 invånare. Vi har 766 vårdplatser och cirka 5 000 anställda fördelade på 20 avdelningar, däribland 16 somatiska och psykiatriska avdelningar.

Vi erbjuder en gedigen forskningsmiljö med 13 professorer och en stark yrkesmässig utbildningsmiljö, där vi varje år välkomnar cirka 2 700 studenter, elever och läkare som deltar i vidareutbildning.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Hardware Engineer: Lead the integration of the hardware that powers ambitious satellite missions
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Hardware Engineer to drive the integration, technical ownership, and continuous improvement of the hardware platforms that enable GomSpace's satellite missions.

You will join our Satellite Systems Business Unit in Aalborg and play a central role in supporting satellite missions from proposal and electrical design through assembly, integration, testing, and delivery to customers worldwide. You will work closely with hardware designers, systems engineers, AIV engineers, manufacturing teams, and project managers while helping shape the future development of our hardware engineering capabilities.

Your Role

As experienced Hardware Engineer, you will act as the technical lead for the integration of electrical hardware and GomSpace products into satellite platforms.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Own the technical integration of GomSpace products into nanosatellite and microsatellite missions.

• Serve as a product expert for GomSpace hardware platforms, interfaces, functionality, configuration, and performance.

• Drive technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis during development, integration, testing, and customer projects.

• Lead the integration and verification of new GomSpace products and third-party hardware within satellite platforms.

• Define electrical interface solutions, schematic-level designs, harness concepts, and supporting hardware required for mission integration.

• Coordinate prototyping, validation, documentation, and manufacturing introduction activities for new hardware solutions.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers.

• Support technical decision-making and trade-off analyses across customer programmes and internal developments.

• Contribute to process improvements, engineering standards, and product maturity initiatives across the organisation.

• Support proposal activities and customer discussions by providing credible technical solutions, effort estimates, and engineering input.

• Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively in English, including technical reports, specifications, procedures, and interactions with international stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

In the initial phase, success means:

• Becoming a recognised technical expert on GomSpace's hardware portfolio.

• Successfully leading hardware integration activities on active customer missions.

• Resolving complex technical issues through systematic troubleshooting and engineering analysis.

• Building strong working relationships with Satellite Systems HW Team, Products HW Team, AIV, Manufacturing, and Systems Engineering.

• Supporting the growth and development of less experienced engineers.

Over time, you will be recognised as a trusted technical authority for hardware integration and product implementation, driving engineering excellence and helping scale GomSpace's hardware capabilities as our missions and teams continue to grow.

What You Bring

You are an experienced hardware engineer who enjoys solving technically demanding challenges and transforming complex products into reliable space systems.

You likely bring:

• An MSc or BSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in hardware design, hardware integration, electronics development, verification, or systems integration.

• Strong knowledge of digital electronics, embedded hardware, and microcontroller-based systems.

• Experience with hardware communication interfaces and buses, including RS485/-422, CAN, SPI, I²C, USB, Ethernet, Spacewire, or similar.

• Experience in schematic capture and hardware development using tools such as Altium Designer or equivalent.

• Understanding of PCB design principles, EMC-, grounding- and shielding considerations, manufacturing processes, and product industrialisation.

• Experience with electrical integration, harness design, laboratory testing, and troubleshooting.

• Practical understanding of power systems, communication systems, and embedded electronics.

• Experience working with multidisciplinary engineering teams and complex technical projects.

• Knowledge of space systems and ECSS standards would be a strong advantage.

• Experience leading technical activities, mentoring engineers, or coordinating engineering teams would be considered a significant benefit.

Who You Are

You are pragmatic, technically curious, and motivated by solving challenging engineering problems.

You are known for:
